display_long_description:
Join **Slash Rivals** fight with various weapon and transform with super power. Have wonderful combat experience and grow amazing skills along with friends! Collect more transformation and become stronger! ⚔️[media]
**Join here→ https://discord.gg/slashrivals**

**🦾 Unleash Ultimate Transformations**

Fill your combat aura, then use your Ult to trigger a devastating super move. But that’s not all — find forbidden altars across the map to unlock Transformations. 🏆
[media]

**🎯 ⚔️ Forge Unique Combat Builds**

Mix and match weapons, but the real power lies in your Gloves. Socket rare Gems into them to unlock dozens of Perks — from life‑stealing slashes to shockwave stomps. Every Slasher plays differently. Collect Stash (the hard‑earned currency of the realm) to trade for new gloves and gem blueprints. Your build, your signature.🏹
[media]



**🎉 🐉 Colossal Boss Fights**

Stumble upon towering zone bosses that roam free — each with unique phases, weak spots, and personality. These aren’t waiting in an instance. 🎙️

**✨ FEATURES:**
- ⚔️ melee & ranged weapons to master
- 👥 Open gate challenge (private or public lobbies)
- 🐉 Transformations with  ultimate skill
- 🛋️ Social hubs to upgrade, chill, and show off
